Written for SPEC-20261122-next-flow-skills-agents (REQ-6, REQ-7, text slice B; decisions D-4, D-5, D-6): the one audit contract, at most 6144 bytes. What the auditor receives, what it returns, which session records the verdict (a card note read by the lander) and that the author of a change never audits it, with five side rules: a local code review of the base..head range without its fix or comment options, a re-audit to the first auditor, a lane's tree-bound check receipt, no forked or advisor session, and a finding without file and line counts as none. It absorbs the former internal review note, whose two security sentences keep their pins (tests/core_rules_2876.rs), and points to RUN's check-run rules instead of restating them. Named by the AUDIT row of chains/index.md and by the moai-audit agent's body.
